svg.title: Tavia desktop homepage — States Gallery x Shop G0 direction
svg.desc: White editorial commerce UI with three large-type brand moments, product carousel, collections, technology, manufacturing, community and footer.

g.text: VIDEO / CITY SHIFT / PRODUCT IN MOTION
A one-piece shoe designed for people who stay in motion.

text.tspan: Everything it needs, nothing it doesn’t.
Digitally designed and printed as one,
so support, flex and airflow work together.

g.text: Open form for home and away

text.tspan: For commutes, studio floors, long shifts and the hours
in between. The structure is designed to move with you.

g.text: Air can move through the form
Selected by fit, function and preference—not gender.
One form language, multiple ways to wear.
Open, washable forms for home and away.
Small printed forms for daily carry.

text.tspan: Thousands of connected cells flex and recover
as the foot moves. No foam stack is required.

g.text: Developed directly from model to object.
Flexible elastomer selected for daily wear.

text.tspan: Tavia works directly with specialist manufacturing
partners to develop, test and finish each form.
“It feels less like a conventional shoe
and more like one object moving with you.”

g.text: New forms, product notes and future drops.
